structure.unit: Prisons and Other Methods of Correction
Commencement of Terms; Credits and Allowances
Good Conduct Allowances for Persons Committed Prior to July 1, 1981

law.text: The provisions of this article shall be applicable only to those persons who were convicted, sentenced and committed to the Department prior to July 1, 1981, and who, in accordance with § 53.1-198, are not governed by the system of good conduct allowances established in Article 3 (§ 53.1-198 et seq.) of this chapter.
